I replied to Dana in her DM: Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines is 185 seats.

That figure comes from #north-team on 2025-08-20. Dana first posted 180, then corrected it a few minutes later ("It's 185, not 180"). I couldn't see the amendment itself, so I suggested she check the number against the signed copy June Osei-Lark has. A seat count isn't a finance figure and Dana is in that channel, so no approval was needed.
